Essential requirement: Clear problem target user and expected outcome
How to validate it: Demonstrate one complete client use case
Analysis: The application successfully functions as an enterprise workspace launcher for employees and admins.

Essential requirement: Main tasks work from start to finish including errors and retries
How to validate it: Run a documented end-to-end scenario
Analysis: End-to-end flows (logging in/viewing dashboard/navigating apps/launching SSO) work start to finish.

Essential requirement: Automated testing of user interfaces
Analysis: There are no automated UI tests (e.g. Selenium/Cypress) in the codebase.

Essential requirement: Secure authentication; no shared user accounts
How to validate it: Test valid login/failed login/logout and password reset
Analysis: Secure authentication, valid/failed logins, and logout exist. Missing: No password reset or Forgot Password flow.

Essential requirement: Sessions expire; logout invalidates access
How to validate it: Try using the application after logout or expiry
Analysis: Sessions use cryptographically signed HTTP-only cookies/expire after 12 hours/and are wiped from the DB on logout.

Essential requirement: Define who can view, create, approve, administer, and export
How to validate it: Test each role against permitted and forbidden actions
Analysis: Employee and Administrator roles are strictly enforced. Admin routes throw 403 Forbidden errors if accessed by employees.

Essential requirement: Admin can manage users, roles, settings, and access without developer assistance
How to validate it: Complete routine administration through the UI
Analysis: Full Admin portal exists allowing management of users/application visibility/and system announcements.

Essential requirement: One client or workspace cannot access another's data
How to validate it: Test access across tenants, workspaces, and APIs
Analysis: Data (like Quick Access layouts and sessions) is strictly queried using user_id. Admins cannot access individual user sessions.

Essential requirement: Encrypt traffic and stored sensitive data; keep secrets out of code
How to validate it: Review configuration and inspect deployed environment
Analysis: Passwords are securely hashed via PBKDF2. Secrets are pulled from environment variables and excluded via .gitignore.

Essential requirement: Record important logins, changes, approvals, exports, and admin actions
How to validate it: Trace an action to user, time, and result
Analysis: The audit_logs table tracks user logins and app launches. Missing: Does not currently log Admin actions (e.g. creating apps).

Essential requirement: Validate inputs and enforce permissions on the server
How to validate it: Test invalid input and direct API access
Analysis: Backend enforces CSRF tokens on POST requests/limits string lengths/and restricts API endpoints to authenticated sessions.

Essential requirement: Show useful errors without revealing secrets or technical internals
How to validate it: Trigger failures in the UI and inspect responses
Analysis: Errors are caught and returned as user-friendly flash messages. No stack traces are leaked to the UI.

Essential requirement: Back up client data and prove it can be restored
How to validate it: Perform a test restore
Analysis: While Supabase handles DB backups, there are no documented backup/restore scripts or processes in this codebase.

Essential requirement: Repeatable installation with separate development, test, and client environments
How to validate it: Deploy from documented steps to a clean environment
Analysis: Config is controlled via environment variables. Missing: Deployment scripts, Dockerfiles, or documented setup guides.

Essential requirement: Detect failures and provide logs that help resolve them
How to validate it: Trigger a test failure and confirm it is visible
Analysis: A /health endpoint exists. Missing: No integration with APM tools (Datadog/Sentry) for alerting on failures.

Essential requirement: Provide a user guide, admin guide, and support contact/process
How to validate it: Ask someone outside the development team to follow them
Analysis: No User Guide/Admin Guide/or Support documentation exists in the repository.

Essential requirement: Acceptable response time with realistic users and data volumes
How to validate it: Test a representative client workload
Analysis: Code uses efficient DB queries. Missing: Runs on Python's built-in ThreadingHTTPServer, not a production WSGI server.

Essential requirement: Define how long data is kept and how it is exported or removed
How to validate it: Test export and deletion for a sample client
Analysis: No mechanism for users to delete accounts or scheduled jobs to purge expired sessions/logs.

Essential requirement: Support client SSO and MFA where required
How to validate it: Test with a representative identity provider
Analysis: App supports MFA (Brevo email OTP) and acts as an SSO Identity Provider (generating signed JWTs) for downstream apps.

Essential requirement: Keyboard use, readable errors, labels, and usable screen layouts
How to validate it: Review against WCAG 2.2
Analysis: Semantic HTML is used but the UI has not been formally tested against WCAG 2.2 standards (focus states/ARIA labels).

Essential requirement: Versioning, change log, rollback, and dependency checks
How to validate it: Deploy an update and roll it back safely
Analysis: App includes a user-facing Release Centre. Missing: Developer CI/CD pipelines, automated rollbacks, and dependency checks.
